title: Buy gold when platinum's own short trend is up and gold's is down

rule.signal: metal close > its SMA20 and gold close < its SMA20
rule.entry: next gold daily open, long only, stop 2 x ATR(20), out at the 5th close, one at a time
rule.costs: $0.60 a round trip + nights() x FIN.xau.long x entry
rule.baseline: same-side long after every eligible day of the same calendar year
rule.placebo: 40 seeds: same signal count per year drawn from gold-below-SMA20 days

tests.what: platinum close above its SMA20 and gold close below its SMA20: buy gold (primary)
platinum OR silver close above its SMA20 and gold close below its SMA20: buy gold
